pages.text: Forget the experts for a moment. I want to talk about investment tax today. In my view this is the best choice for ordinary savers. I am strongly positive about it and tell everyone I know. Dividends are not taxed at all in this market.

Different instruments are taxed differently, and the rate depends on the type of income and the investor's residence. A final tax means the investor has no further tax to pay on that income. Do your own research before you act. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
